No bill-of-lading number, date, destination or HS code could be read. domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender, contract or annual-report split found. Search engines were non-functional for this query (Bing returned unrelated pages), so absence of evidence here is a tooling limitation, not proof of no domestic supply.
